android.desc:
Here is the Object Counter By Camera App. You can count things with this counting app via the camera in a shot. example tings：tablet、pills、pipes、coins、boxes、rods、lumber

Count objects automatically and counts things from photos

Take a photo of things you want to count, highlight one of the items and get the result.

It can be used to count thing, as an inventory counting tool

Object Counter By Camera App will count literally anything you show it

quotes.text:
I thought it was an AI object counting app, the kind that made headlines 8 years back. Nope, completely manual.

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=xz.camera.objectcounter&hl=en_IN
quotes.story_title: The Fed says this is a cube of $1M. They're off by half a million
